name: Stand-Up India Scheme (SUPI)
summary: Bank loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs starting a new enterprise.
description: Bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore for SC, ST and women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises.
implementingAuthority: Scheduled Commercial Banks; SIDBI (Stand-Up India portal)

evidence.quote: Composite Loan between Rs.10 lakh and Rs.1 crore to entrepreneurs above 18 years of age, through Scheduled Commercial Banks (SCBs);

criteria.label: SC or ST entrepreneur, or a woman entrepreneur

evidence.quote: The Stand-up India Scheme was launched on 5th April, 2016 to promote entrepreneurship among the Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes and Women.

criteria.label: Loan is for a new (greenfield) project in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activities

evidence.quote: For setting up greenfield projects in manufacturing, services or trading sector and activities allied to agriculture;

benefits.text: Composite loan between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore, repayable over up to 7 years with an 18-month moratorium.

evidence.quote: Repayment of the loan in a span of upto seven years including moratorium period of 18 months;

applicationProcess: Apply at a bank branch, through the Stand-Up India portal (www.standupmitra.in), or through the Lead District Manager.

evidence.quote: the SUPI Scheme is upto 31.03.2025, in line with the 15th Finance Commission.

sources.title: Stand Up India Scheme (SUPI)
sources.publisher: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
sources.evidenceNotes: 'Features' list and the note on scheme tenure.

sources.title: Stand-Up India Scheme Guidelines
sources.evidenceNotes: Nature of loan, margin money, 51% shareholding rule for non-individual enterprises.

warnings: DFS says SUPI runs up to 31.03.2025 and a successor scheme was announced in Budget 2025-26. Shown as not currently open until a newer official notice is captured.
